note: outside the 12 cells: 朝日町 商港岸壁 around the south pylon of the かなえ大橋. OSM has the whole area as landuse=construction (48,014 m2); the east part is a finished paved quay apron in 2026. The west part (x < ~1062) is still bare-earth works with a crane barge and a silt fence (vfy-asahi-w), so the OSM construction polygon is kept and the apron draws over it.
